title: The Wasp by Morgan Lloyd Malcolm #thewaspplay #littleenginetheater #s...
transcript: Is this the best psychological thriller since Job? The Wasp is another two-hander that keeps you guessing and moves at lightning speed for a truly riveting experience. Written by Morgan Lloyd Malcolm and starring Colby Minifie and Amy Forsyth, it's about two women who reconnect after almost 20 years when one of them has a mysterious business proposition. This is rather unexpected since they have a tumultuous history as former schoolmates. What unfolds is a windy and honestly, pretty disturbing story that tests morality when it comes to rehashing and reclaiming trauma — must we lead with empathy and kindness, or is there a place for violence and revenge? I won't say much more, but I thought this was a really great piece and I was hooked all the way up to the very last moment. The potency in the performances and the writing is visceral and immediate, and the intimate space only adds to that edge of your seat feeling. Little Engine Theater is currently presenting the Wasp through next Saturday, November 15th. With that, another program for my collection.
